title: Nice towels but are small and get smaller after washing; definitely not luxury
text:
Nice towels but are small and get smaller after washing; definitely not luxury. These towels feel thick and mostly it's because of the tire-track design. They measure 19 inches x 16 inches before they are washed and they shrink to 17 inches x 16 inches after washing and drying. They dry my dishes well and are absorbent. I also like that there's no lint that is transferred to my dishes. I do not mind that they are small and overall I feel these are okay; however, they are definitely not luxury as specified and they do get smaller after the first washing and I probably would not buy them because of that.

To me luxury towels should be thick, plush, and not shrink.
